PRIORITY COUNT/FRAMING FIX: Exactly THREE separate identical TWO-STOREY growing RACKS, all the SAME physical height, each standing on the ground with four feet and exactly two trays. Show THREE top crossbars and SIX complete planted trays. Never add a third floor to a rack. Arrange two in front and the third behind-left with enough side offset/gap for its lower tray and four feet to remain visible; connect via short thick rear pipes. Pull camera FAR BACK so all feet and all geometry have a broad 15 percent empty border. Elevated view about45deg reveals the L-shaped footprint and all THREE independent frames. Background remains plain, no ground platform.

EXACT THREE MEGA RACKS: Preserve TWO complete front mega racks from image5, each with two vertically stacked planted trays. Add exactly ONE matching entire rack BEHIND the left rack, forming an L-shaped 2x2 grid (rear-right empty). Total THREE racks and SIX planted trays. Connect by thick irrigation pipes, do not merge their individual frame outlines. Show all three upper trays and enough of all three lower trays to count them. Use ample margin at least 10 percent around the entire assembly, pull camera back. No new rack in front of original row.

MEGA-LAYER CATEGORY: Replace previous large beds with exactly the current number of broad TWO-STOREY stepped cultivation deck modules. Each mega module has two integrated terracotta-rim growing balconies on a thick sage structural core, tall enough to clearly differ from a single raised bed. No enclosed greenhouse yet. Couple all modules within the parcel; no separate scenic buildings.

REFERENCE PRIORITY: image 4 (the accepted T01 asset) defines the exact family DNA, FRONT and shape language. Image 5, when supplied, is the accepted immediate predecessor. Images 1-3 are MATERIAL/PALETTE inspiration only; NEVER copy their whole buildings, props, layout or lighting. Render exactly the current tier described below, not the style-reference scene. Never add boxes, crates, loose props or extra symbols. All lamps OFF, all glass non-emissive, no glow. Thick rounded clean forms, broad painted color areas.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one final Meshy image-to-3D building reference for Weedtopia Inc / Burning Hills.
Subject: botanical cultivation module, T15_L900. Exact visible state: exactly 3 mega cultivation layers.
Family DNA: rounded thick-rim planters, readable green foliage masses, front irrigation collar. Function: botanical cultivation module.
Progression: The exact number and category above completely replace the previous cultivation configuration; never add the previous pots or beds as extra modules. Keep one connected asset; coupled units use a compact 2 by 2 arrangement. Plants have chunky clustered foliage, no isolated thin leaves or floating parts.
Scale: maximum reserved parcel 12m local X by 12m local Z, maximum family height 25m. This reserved envelope is NOT a visible base. See asset_spec.de.md for this tier's approximate occupied dimensions; render the whole current object, not an empty full-size plot.
Front and camera: local +Y up, front facing +Z, front stays on the lower-left visible face of the image, local +X side on lower-right. Camera at local (+X,+Y,+Z), about 35 degrees elevated, near orthographic 3/4 front view. Never mirror. Ground-center pivot intent; future growth is upward and toward local -Z. The entry and delivery zones stay on +Z.
Materials: terracotta, sage enamel, reclaimed wood, restrained thick green glass; epoch treatment: matte concrete, olive enamel, larger integrated service modules. Broad hand-painted color areas and large restrained wear patches. Rounded/beveled silhouettes, thick reconstructable parts, modular retro technology, one or at most two eventual material slots. Green glass must be thick and legible. At most one dominant botanical or grinder motif.
Reference input roles: Image 1 Reclaimed Green Haven gives warm rebuilt shapes and readability; image 2 Herbal Atom Age gives rounded enamel machines and copper/brass; image 3 Burning Hills Afterglow gives hopeful worldbuilding only, NOT its dusk lighting, environment or people. Additional inputs, when present: the family's accepted T01 geometry anchor, then its immediately preceding accepted tier. Preserve their family identity, front and proportions while making the specified large upgrade visible. For T00 use only the intact T01 as extra geometry reference. For T01 or T_FIXED only the three style inputs are supplied.
Composition: exactly one single complete freestanding asset, centered and grounded; square 1024x1024 or larger, generous 10 percent clear margin all around. Plain solid very light warm-gray/off-white background. Neutral even studio light; one soft contact shadow only. All geometry entirely visible.
Technical intent: stylized game-ready smart-topology, clean edges, minimal geometry; no floating parts. Attached architectural planting is allowed; no loose props. A park may contain its intrinsic bounded planted parcel, never a surrounding scenic diorama.
Exclude: people, characters, vehicles, conveyor belts, surrounding scene, landscape, city, unrelated buildings, loose props, diorama ground, text, readable signs, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, weapons, gore, smoking, smoke, particles, thin antennae, tangled cables, clipped or cropped geometry, baked dramatic shadows, glows, fog or dusk color casts.
review_notes: Drei gleich hohe, vollständige zweigeschossige Mega-Rahmen mit sechs Pflanzdecks; zwei Frontmodule, drittes versetzt dahinter. Hinteres unteres Deck sichtbar, Rohrverbund plausibel, alle Füße vollständig mit Rand. Frontanschlüsse zu derselben freien Frontseite.
